summary: Two planes collided mid-air over north Boulder, killing 3 people; RMRG conducted a multi-day evidence search (500 person-hours over 3 operational periods) for wreckage and remains to aid the NTSB crash investigation.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Front Range Rescue Dogs; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Arapahoe Rescue Patrol
notes: Evidence/recovery mission for NTSB, no survivors to rescue. Added 2026-09-10 from RMRG 2010 missions-of-note page + 2010 annual report.
